item.title: [−1] Jet fuel raised ₹1.37 a litre to ₹138.50, a fourth monthly rise; commercial LPG up ₹10 to ₹2,820
item.description:
Household LPG held at ₹942 per cylinder. Second straight monthly hike in commercial LPG as international benchmarks firm. Ongoing pass-through of high oil.

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Commercial LPG costlier

Why it matters: Dearer jet fuel squeezes airline margins and fares; commercial LPG adds to restaurant and small-business costs, while frozen household prices keep the subsidy burden on the state.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
